title: Fungal Corneal Ulcer

steps.tx: **Fungal corneal ulcer** follows vegetative trauma in agricultural workers, dry raised grey white infiltrate with feathery edges, satellite lesions and often hypopyon disproportionate to surface size. Course is slower and deeper than bacterial ulcer, worsening on antibacterial or steroid therapy classically. Potassium hydroxide mount of scraping gives rapid hyphae evidence while culture confirms species slowly.
steps.say: Vegetative trauma together gives feathery fungal pattern in agricultural workers characteristically during harvest seasons in endemic regions. Rapid mount gives hyphae evidence before culture. Steroid worsening gives history clue.

steps.tx: **Feathery margins** with satellite infiltrates separate fungal from bacterial smooth edged ulcers at slit lamp, though overlap needs microbiology in every severe case. Dry texture and raised surface add bedside weight before mount results. Endothelial plaque below ulcer signals deep fungal penetration toward chamber invasion.
steps.say: Feathery edges together give fungal separation from bacterial ulcers at slit lamp during assessment in tropical clinics characteristically. Dry raised texture gives bedside weight additionally. Deep plaque gives penetration warning.

steps.tx: **Satellite lesions** are smaller infiltrates separated from main ulcer by clearer cornea where hyphae seed discontinuously, a pattern bacteria rarely produce. Their presence raises fungal priority in scraping media selection, fungal plates and stains requested explicitly. Communication with laboratory therefore includes fungal suspicion phrase, not ulcer unspecified.
steps.say: Separated satellites together give fungal priority in laboratory requests at scraping in severe ulcers in clinic. Explicit suspicion gives media selection value. Bacterial rarity gives pattern weight.

steps.tx: Filamentous fungi dominate tropical vegetative disease while yeast dominates immunocompromised or post surgical corneas in temperate settings, antifungal choice following mount morphology initially. Therapy is prolonged weeks, penetration limited, surgery earlier for deep or non responding disease than bacterial equivalents. **Slow response** expectation prevents premature therapy switching in fungal protocols.
steps.say: Morphology together gives initial antifungal direction before species culture in fungal protocols at referral centres over weeks. Prolonged course gives response expectation setting. Deep disease gives earlier surgery.

steps.tx: Steroid history worsening fungal ulcer is diagnostic clue and therapeutic prohibition until fungal control established under specialist care. steps.tx: Therapeutic keratoplasty in fungal disease needs wider margins because hyphae extend beyond visible infiltrate, recurrence in graft commoner than bacterial grafts. Postoperative antifungal continuation and recurrence surveillance extend months. **Margin generosity** is fungal graft principle examinations contrast with bacterial tectonic urgency.
steps.say: Margin generosity together gives fungal graft principle at therapeutic surgery in referral centres for deep ulcers failing therapy. Recurrence surveillance gives months duration afterward. Visible edge gives underestimation warning.

steps.tx: Prevention in agricultural belts is protective eyewear during harvest and immediate care for vegetative injuries, public health reducing perforation burden substantially. Delayed presentation predicts perforation and endophthalmitis more than organism virulence in outcome studies. **Injury day presentation** campaigns therefore target farmers before ulcer microbiology begins.
steps.say: Protective eyewear together gives perforation prevention in harvest injury programmes across agricultural belts in endemic regions. Early presentation gives outcome dominance additionally. Campaign timing gives harvest targeting.
